processing_notes: Source states: 'During the most recent reporting period from 12 to 26 March 2026, 33 new suspected cases and 4 deaths were recorded ... The outbreak affects several departments, including Congo-Oubangui (particularly Mossaka-Loukolela, the most severely impacted area), Brazzaville (notably Ile Mbamou and Talangai), Likouala, and Nkeni-Alima, with recent cases reported in Mossaka (16 cases and 4 deaths) and Ile Mbamou (17 cases). According to the latest epidemiological updates from the Ministry of Health, particularly SITREP 36 published on 27 March 2026' - interpreted as 16 sCh cases, 4 deaths. Interpreted as 16 sCh and 4 deaths in the LIRANGA health area/district, 12-26 March 2026 (content of MoH SITREP 36, which is not published). LOCATION INFERENCE (documented): the source says 'Mossaka', but SITREPs N34-N36 still grouped Loukolela, Liranga, Mossaka, Boleko and Loboko health areas under one 'DS de Mossaka' (SITREP N34 Tableau I); Mossaka district proper had only 8 cases and 0 deaths in the whole 2026 wave (SITREP N46/N48 Tableau: 'Mossaka | Vague 2026 8 0'), so 16 cases / 4 deaths cannot be Mossaka proper, whereas Liranga's increment between SITREP N35 (12 Mar) and N42 (28 Apr) is exactly 16 cases / 4 deaths (former Index 110; Liranga cumulative 158/17 -> 174/21). ARITHMETIC: 16 + 17 (Ile Mbamou) = 33 = national new cases; 4 = national new deaths (N35 1,041/87 -> SITREP 36 1,074/91). Replaces the coarser retracted Index 110 (Liranga 2026-03-12..04-27, 16/4); the remainder 2026-03-27..04-27 is a documented zero (Liranga cumulative 174/21 unchanged from SITREP 36 to N42 and N45). Provincial subset - do not sum with national row. Small-number CFR (4/16) in a remote riverine health area; confidence 0.7. [AGENT 2 REVISION 2026-09-29] [AGENT 2 UNCERTAINTY NOTE 2026-09-29] Alternative reading kept open: SITREP 36's 'Mossaka (16 cases and 4 deaths)' refers to the old 'DS de Mossaka' grouping (Liranga + Loukolela + Mossaka health areas). The N35->N42 increments were Liranga 16/4, Loukolela 6/0, Mossaka 8/0, so the 16 could in principle be Mossaka 8 + Loukolela 6 + Liranga 2 (all 4 deaths are Liranga's under either reading). The Liranga-only reading is preferred because SITREP N34 used the identical wording ('51 dans le DS de Mossaka') when all 51 new cases were in the Liranga health area (N34 Tableau I), Liranga was the active focus in Feb-Mar 2026, and the 4 deaths equal Liranga's exactly.
